The mode colour bar on each Tasks tab row is now a 4px-wide pill with 2px rounded corners, inset from the row's edges. `piton check` reports no problems and `piton build` wrote 82 files.

You didn't give inset sizes, so I chose them: 4px from the left and 6px from the top and bottom. That leaves a 16px-tall pill in each 28px row, and bars in neighbouring rows never touch. Say if you want different insets.
